stated: The Conservative Party will improve support for people who have guide or assistance dogs in the next Parliament.

source.quote: In the next Parliament we will improve support for people who have guide or assistance dogs and explore bidding to host and deliver the 2031 Special Olympics World Summer Games.

bearing_set.reason: Guide/assistance dog users are disabled people whose primary reported problem is unlawful refusal of access by taxis, restaurants and other services — an equal-treatment/anti-discrimination matter squarely within O9's scope; policy improvements here would earn a real verdict on legal protections and enforcement for a protected characteristic.

membership_note: The policy is very loosely stated ('improve support' with no specified mechanism), so most potential spillovers (e.g. O12 fiscal effect, O13 productivity) cannot be pinned to a concrete mechanism. The one genuine, non-negligible bearing is on equal treatment and disability anti-discrimination (O9).
